profile_text.body:
CDW is a public company, traded under the ticker CDW, that describes itself as a provider of information technology products, expertise and services for business. Its site emphasizes fast shipping, fast answers, large in-stock inventories, and custom configurations. It presents itself as a source of IT solutions and services spanning hardware and software.

On artificial intelligence, CDW's site frames the company as an advisor and deployment partner rather than a builder of AI models. It highlights AI-ready hardware such as Surface Laptops, Microsoft Surface Copilot+ PCs, Logitech's Rally AI Camera and Rally AI Camera Pro, and the Mac mini with its M6 chip, which the site describes as bringing AI performance for on-device workflows. The site also discusses data quality and governance as a foundation for trusted AI, infrastructure modernization for AI readiness, and AI adoption in government agencies and retail, where it argues a people-first strategy and smart data management drive better outcomes.

The record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for CDW. Its profile lists it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001402057.
